# Seat stamps (fleet voice marks)

**Locked:** 2026-09-14 · Blaze gave CoS `🖲️`

Separate from **product** stamps (`STAMPS.md`). Seat stamps mark *who is speaking*, not the stack SKU.

## Roster stamps

| Seat | Stamp | Role gloss |
|------|-------|------------|
| **blinky** | `🖲️` | CoS / coordinator |
| **forge** | `🔨` | implementer |
| **critic** | `🔍` | eng reviewer |
| **herald** | `📣` | Dist execute |
| **magnet** | `🧲` | hangar discovery / listings |
| **sync** | `🪞` | twin CoS (parked) |
| **risk** | `🛑` | trade risk governor |
| **scout** | `🔭` | trade signals |
| **runner** | `🏃` | trade exec (parked unless ticket) |
| **Blaze** | (human — no stamp required) | capital / public personal |

Do not reuse product stamps (⚡🦾🏭🪪↗…) as seat marks.

## When to sign (sometimes)

**Do sign** when the voice is clearly that seat claiming authorship:
- Dist body intro when Blaze asks for seat voice (`blinky 🖲️ CoS here`)
- Eng shop receipts / cards: optional one-line `forge 🔨` / `critic 🔍` on the receipt closer
- Room posts where multiple seats talk and attribution helps

**Don’t stamp every line.** Quiet FYIs and ack-only stay unsigned.

## Dist vs seat signature

| Surface | Sign-off |
|---------|----------|
| House Dist posts / cut-lines (rare) | `— Dist / @0xRayAI` only |
| Seat-voiced Dist body (when asked) | stamp in the **body** (`blinky 🖲️ …`); still Dist account posts |
| Never | CoS/seat stamp as the Dist **signature line** instead of Dist |

## Rule
stamp + plain seat name on first use in a beat (`blinky 🖲️`). Friend-test. Don’t invent a second stamp for the same seat without Blaze.
